why: The blocking bug comment names the seeded bug: created_at.date() gives the UTC date, not the London date, so during BST orders placed between 00:00 and 01:00 London time are counted on the previous day. It also proposes the fix, london_day. The review has 7 findings: the bug, a design question, duplication, three minor items and missing tests. Two are blocking: the bug and the missing tests.
